macros.name: thnameref
macros.doc: There are three commands available for producing references to your theorems: \ref{〈foo〉} gives the number, as usual; \thref{〈foo〉} gives the theorem name followed by number; and \thnameref{〈foo〉} gives just the theorem name.

macros.name: thref
